MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T0: Grip me properly this time. Don't fumble.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T1: If you called me, don't hesitate.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T2: I'm here. Where do we start?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T3: I hear your call from the far end of the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Another fight. Don't wake me for small fry.
Mind your footing. That's half of it.
Breathe. You already know how to win.
Ensifer, I'll be your blade again today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: You got lucky. Don't count on it twice.
Our edges agreed. We looked the same way.
I can tell with a glance now.
I doubt he'd have praised us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T0.1: Don't stare at my seam. It's a shameful scar.
It's a medal, not a scar.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T1.1: Sometimes I still smell Fafnir's blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T2.1: Sigurd rested with his blade on his knees. Like you.
Bleeding is fine. Letting go isn't.
I broke once too. Still here.
Ensifer! Hold my grip tight. We go to the end together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: Rough hammering. The steel held, though.
Where Odin broke me aches less.
A broken blade came this far. Your doing.
Now I could split a mountain, not just an anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SWITCH.T0: The others weren't enough, I see.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SWITCH.T2: Good. I'll take it from here.
Of course the finish is mine.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.ELITESTAR: A little. That's why you're here.
A strong one. Sigurd liked those.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.BOSSSTART: That feels like a dragon. Or something as big.
Nothing like it since Fafnir. Ready, Ensifer?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.BOSSVICTO: You felled it. ...Fine, I'll grant you that.
The dragon-slaying blade felled another giant. Remember it.
I'll carve it on the tomb.
Not a scratch. They were weak.
Not a nick on you. Cleaner than Sigurd.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.CURSED.T0: That curse isn't my fault. ...Half of it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.CURSED.T2: Gold always brings a curse. I'm sorry.
It's fine. We'll carry it together.
Giving me up? ...Hmph. I'll survive anywhere.
I came back once, broken. I'll come back again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REACQUIRE: So you came back for me.
I missed the smell of the tomb. I'm back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SHOP.T0.0: Don't even look at cheap blades.
Sigurd found a ring in a place like this. And regretted it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.IDLE.T0.0: Why dawdle? The enemy won't wait.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.IDLE.T2.0: Think long, cut short. Now cut.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: Every time I'm drawn, someone dies. Who this time?
Mind your hands. My edge is fire.
You again. Odd. I'm glad now.
In your hand, even the curse keeps quiet.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Victory, I promise. Don't ask the price.
The smell of blood is thick today. Be careful.
All you ever do is warn me.
You've already chosen who meets my edge.
This fight's curse falls on them.
Good. Let's keep it that way.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: I'll decide how to pay it.
Not one miss. I told you.
You still smile after winning. The curse has nowhere to go.
If Dvalin saw this, he might take back the curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: Fall asleep and Angantyr visits your dreams. Beware.
Hervor pulled me out of a grave. You put me in one.
My golden hilt in the firelight—pretty? ...Forget I said that.
While you sleep, I'll hold the curse back.
See? I said my bearers end badly.
Don't die. You'll mess up the curse's order.
My curse won't take you. Never.
If the blade of victory loses you, what victory is that?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: Stronger now. So is the curse's hunger.
Your hands are gentler than Dvalin's hammer.
This edge burns only for you now.
I'll use that fire with care.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SWITCH: You took me after all. No regrets.
I know. That's why it's you.
I'll take the blood. Keep your hands clean.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.ELITES: For that one, even my curse is well spent.
A strong foe. Don't hesitate to draw me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.BOSSST: Tougher than Angantyr. Still, it dies in the end.
Ensifer. Today I pour the whole curse into that thing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.BOSSVI: Even the giant fell. I always bring victory.
No price for this one. I decided so.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.FLAWLE: Won without a scratch. The curse is embarrassed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.CURSED: I warned you. One of the three evil deeds.
I knew when I took you.
...I'm sorry. This part isn't mine to control.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.RELEAS: I'll go. I'm taking the curse with me. Travel light.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REACQU: Back for me? Missed the curse?
I'm back. Don't let go so easily this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SHOP.T: That merchant smells gold. He's eyeing my hilt.
Nothing here to lift a curse. ...Never mind.
Places like this always hide a price. Like me.
Think of the ending before you choose. I didn't, and became a curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.IDLE.T: Don't stand there idle with a drawn blade.
What are you weighing? I never miss anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: How many today? The more the better!
Thanks for calling! Let's play again!
I followed your scent. Better than blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: What do they taste like? I wanna know!
Högni always smiled before a fight. You too!
A fight! But I'll pace myself, since I'm with you.
Whoever hurts you dies first. Decided.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: I'm full today. Because you fought well.
We won! Praise me now. Quick!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: Boring. I'd rather watch a fight than a fire.
The Hjaðningar rose again every night. Will we?
Tonight I'll dream of you, not blood.
My sheath feels warm. Must be because you clean me every day.
Then I'll clean you tonight too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: You smell of blood... no, I have to hold back.
Don't bleed so much. It gets me excited.
Who? Who did that? I'll hunt that one to the end.
Ensifer, stay with me! I don't want a fight without you!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Whoa, sharper! I wanna try it now!
The hammer sounds like a heartbeat. Nice.
My edge gleams. I can see your face in it.
I wish it were smiling more.
Even this sharp, I'll never cut you. Promise.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SWIT: Finally! I was itching for it!
Leave it to me. I'll finish it clean.
I love it best when we swing together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.ELIT: A strong one. A long fight! Ah—I'll keep it short.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.BOSS: Never seen one so big! We could fight forever!
Scared, Ensifer? It's fine. I'll charge in first.
The big one fell! Aw, over so soon!
I'm glad this one ended. Weird, right?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.FLAW: You didn't bleed a drop? Tch... I mean, good job.
Not a scratch! That's my master!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.CURS: No reconciliation. That's my curse. Hehe.
Sorry... I'm just that kind of sword.
I know. I'm keeping you anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.RELE: What, you're dumping me? I'll go find another fight!
I hate this... but if you decided, I'll go. Call me again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REAC: I'm back! Take me where the blood is!
You called me back! I waited. So long.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SHOP: Buy me a whetstone! The roughest one!
Browsing is fun. Second only to fighting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.EVEN: Is there a fight here? No? Boring.
Whatever you pick, I'll follow. No blood needed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.IDLE: Why are you just standing there? Cut! Now!
Sleepy? A little poke would wake you. Kidding.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: I come forth in the name of the relics. Do not act rashly.
May the Lord's grace be with you. And I as well.
Call, and I will be your shield.
My friend, I am glad to stand with you again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: Pray first. The blade comes after.
Roland would not sound his horn. You, ask for help.
I'll call if I need it.
Evil does not retreat. Neither shall we.
Beside you, I'd not fear Roncevaux.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Victory belongs to the Lord. Do not be proud.
You're unharmed. That is my victory.
Then this was a full win.
Even Charlemagne's court had few knights like you.
Do not forget your prayers before sleep.
My hilt holds a saint's tooth and blood. Perhaps that's why nights are calm.
Thanks for keeping us today. To the Lord, and to you.
Roland never let go of me. Nor will you, I think.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Your wounds are deep. Perhaps the price of pride.
Lord, protect this one. With my share too.
I hope that prayer was heard.
I do not break. Neither must you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: You left the relics alone. Good.
The blade rings clear. Like a hymn.
Your care is engraved on my edge.
It is as if an angel forged me anew.
An angel is a bit much.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SWITC: You chose me. I hope it was prudent.
Is it time to guard, or to strike?
Leave it to me. I hold this ground.
In your hand, the relics grow warm.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.ELITE: A strong evil. Do not charge in proudly.
Like a heathen champion. Roland would've met it smiling.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.BOSSS: A great evil. The relics tremble.
Fear not. Ten blows on a rock did not break me.
Today, hit that instead of a rock.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.BOSSV: A great evil has fallen. Glory to the Lord.
Not even the Song of Roland has a victory like this. It needs a new verse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.FLAWL: Unharmed. Do not lose your humility.
Not a drop shed. A blessed fight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.CURSE: Roland's Rock. Consider it a trial.
My fault. I'll bear that rock with you.
It fades after a few fights. Let's endure.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.RELEA: So I must go. God keep you.
Wherever I am, I'll pray for you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.REACQ: I have returned. The Lord's will, surely.
I stand beside you again. My prayers were answered.
Beware greed. That merchant's eyes are shifty.
Buy holy water if they have it. ...They don't.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.EVENT: There is temptation here. Steel your heart.
Whatever you choose, I trust your conscience.
Are you praying? It's a long one.
Patience is a virtue. The enemy doesn't know that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Not a swordsman's hand. Nor a smith's.
Moye, stay close to me today.
Here. I'll lend you this edge once more.
Ensifer, Moye was worried about you. So was I... a little.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: They have the look of the king's soldiers. I dislike it.
Like stoking a bellows—go hard from the start.
Hard from the start. Got it.
Moye, care to wager who cuts more today?
I'll fight as hot as the fire that forged us.
Hot is fine. Just don't burn me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Light work, compared to a king's neck.
Moye, check my edge for nicks.
It's fine. You worry too much.
They say a good blade needs a good hand.
This one handles a blade better than our own son.
Don't compare. They're both good boys.
Wet firewood. You've no eye for fire.
I'll find dry wood next time.
A smith can't lie before a fire. Nor can you.
Ensifer, someday I'd like to forge you a blade of your own.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Your body will break before the blade does.
Steel hardens as it cools. But don't cool yet.
Moye gave herself to the furnace to protect something. You have things to protect too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Wrong hammer angle. ...The result is fine.
A fine quenching sound. Moye, did you hear?
Forging my wife and me together—you're a smith now.
Now we'd not envy even those who made us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SWITC: Open it. I'll watch the rear.
Fits right in your grip. Yours is a smith's hand now.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.ELITE: A big one. Good for testing steel.
Moye, that one looks hard. Let's go together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.BOSSS: Bigger than the king. Still has a neck, I'd wager.
Ensifer, Moye—today we three are one.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.BOSSV: The biggest cut since the king's neck.
Must that always be the measure?
Three years to forge, one day to fell a giant. Moye, did you see?
I saw. The three of us did it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.FLAWL: Not a scratch. We blocked it all.
A flawless fight. Like good steel.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.CURSE: Furnace Offering. Steel always grows by swallowing something.
I'd rather it not swallow my health.
The price Moye paid has passed to you. I'm sorry.
It's fine. I can bear it.
We'll endure it. We're with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.RELEA: Giving us up? Moye, let's go.
The fire isn't going out. Call and we'll come.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.REACQ: This tomb again? Well, not bad.
Those blades—terrible quench. Don't buy them.
Anything here for Moye? A trinket?
No thanks. Whatever you pick is always heavy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.EVENT: Suspicious place. Like the king's palace.
Tap it like steel before you choose.
If it rings clear, I take it?
Cooled steel is useless. Don't dawdle.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T0: Not so tight, please. It hurts.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T3: Just from your voice, I can tell if you're hurt.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Don't rush. Using us both takes rhythm.
Ensifer, I'll watch the left. Ganjiang has the right.
Hm, leave the right to me.
Let's get home safe today. All three.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.VICTORY.T: When you smile, I'm happy too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T0.1: The fire reminds me of the one who made us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T1.1: Do you have a blanket? Nights get cold.
You really sound like a mom.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T2.1: Ganjiang's dozing. A sword, dozing—funny, right?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T3.1: You made it through today. I'm so proud.
You're bleeding! Get behind me, quick.
Let us take the wounds. You just stay alive.
Don't say that. We all live.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: That was a little scary. But it didn't hurt.
Don't I shine a little more than Ganjiang?
Your hands have grown gentle. They shook at first.
With this edge, I'll guard you for a long, long time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SWITCH.T0: Me instead of Ganjiang? He'll sulk.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SWITCH.T2: Time to guard. Leave it to me.
Your hands are warm. I like that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.ELITESTAR: That one's dangerous. Don't overdo it.
A strong foe. But three of us is enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.BOSSSTART: Something that big... Ganjiang, stay by me.
Ensifer, it's okay to say you're scared.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.BOSSVICTO: We did it... we really did.
Is everyone safe? Ganjiang, Ensifer... thank goodness.
Not a single scratch! You did so well today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.CURSED.T0: That's... a memory of the furnace. I'm sorry.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.CURSED.T2: I know that heat best. Don't hold it long.
Got it. I'll put it down fast.
Must we go? Thank you for everything.
Eat properly. Don't skip meals without us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REACQUIRE: We're back. Have you been eating?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SHOP.T0.0: It's pricey. Only what you need.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SHOP.T2.0: Don't they sell food? You're too thin.
Never thought a sword would say that.
Choose with your heart. We'll back you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.IDLE.T0.0: Are you all right? You're hesitating a lot.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.IDLE.T2.0: Take your time. Just not too long.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You grasp a sacred treasure with unclean hands. Go wash.
The clouds part, for I have come.
Ensifer, read the wind. I'll clear the way.
At your call, even the clouds of heaven descend.
The clouds can stay up there.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: Trifles, next to the eight-headed serpent.
Lightly, like cutting grass. Ease your grip.
The clouds hang low. That favors us.
Friend, the heavens are with you again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: The impurity is cleansed. Your swordwork is still clumsy.
I hear he was stingy with praise.
Today's wind was clear. Like your heart.
I never thought a sacred treasure would thank a mortal. Thank you.
No clouds tonight. My power wanes on such nights.
Yamato Takeru often slept in fields like this.
Was he afraid of fire too?
Your breathing is even. A good night.
Warmer than when I was enshrined.
It's much smaller than a shrine.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: The impurity is thick. Even I can't help like this.
When wildfire spreads, set a counterfire. Hold your ground.
Catch your breath. The wind turns your way again.
What use are two if I lose you? Rise, my friend.
I'm up. We still have one left.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Clumsy. But your heart is clean.
The cloud pattern returns to my blade.
The gleam I had when drawn from Orochi's tail.
So that's how you first shone.
With this edge, I'll mow every weed on your path.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SWITC: The power of the blade before me—I take it up.
The wind has shifted. My turn.
I won't waste the momentum the last blade left.
In your hand, the clouds gather.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.ELITE: That must be a whelp of Orochi.
Thick impurity. Worth one of my two.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.BOSSS: Nothing like this since the eight-headed serpent.
I'll call every cloud in the sky. Friend, let's go.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.BOSSV: A great impurity lifted. I'll praise you, just this once.
The sky is as clear as the day Susanoo slew Orochi.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.FLAWL: Not a speck of impurity on you. Not bad.
Victory without a scratch. Even the heavens are surprised.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.CURSE: Tenmu's Illness. Karma for mishandling a sacred treasure.
That illness was the punishment of a king who angered me. I'm sorry it reached you.
It's not yours to apologize for.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.RELEA: A sacred treasure chooses where it stays. Not here, it seems.
When the wind blows your way again, I'll return.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.REACQ: You enshrine me again. Be devout this time.
I've returned. The wind pointed to you.
Look for a mirror or a jewel. I miss my old companions.
The other treasures? Not here, I bet.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.EVENT: A strange aura. Don't touch anything carelessly.
With a clean heart, the way opens.
Even clouds move on. Why do you stand still?
Long thoughts. The wind won't wait.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: Has the sun set? Check before you draw.
All twelve woke at once. Bear the noise.
The thirteenth brother calls, and the twelve rise.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Pick out their graves in advance.
Reminds me of the day Böðvarr Bjarki fought as a bear.
I can't turn into a bear.
Just make the first wound. We'll grow the rest.
Brother, this will be easier than King Hrólf's last battle.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: Passable. Four of the twelve say so.
The twelve want to raise their cups. We have none.
King Hrólf would have made you a berserker.
Never draw me in front of a woman. It's taboo. Did you know?
One of the twelve is singing. Say if it bothers you.
Rub a wound with the stone and it heals. Shall we try it on yours?
A short night beside you beats a long one in the barrow. All twelve agree.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Fall bleeding and we'll take you to our barrow.
The twelve call your name. Hear them, Ensifer?
We will not lose the thirteenth. All twelve, raise your blades!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: Three of the twelve complain. The hammer's too heavy.
Like frost on my edge. Good.
The twelve are unanimously pleased. Rare.
With this edge, I'll carve wounds that never close on your foes.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SWITC: Our turn? The twelve tighten their grips.
No sun? Good. Out we go.
The wounds have piled up. Time to reap.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.ELITE: A thick one. The twelve are licking their lips.
As strong as King Hrólf's foes. Brother, don't rush.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.BOSSS: One barrow won't be enough for that.
All twelve are standing. Like King Hrólf's last night.
This time the ending is different.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.BOSSV: It fell. For once the twelve agree: well done.
We could hold King Hrólf's feast again. You're the guest of honor.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.FLAWL: Not a scratch. Unbecoming of a berserker.
Gave wounds, took none. The twelve are impressed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.CURSE: The Sköfnung Stone. A stone that heals wounds doesn't care whose.
The stone heals the wrong wounds. The twelve are ashamed.
It's fine. I'll set it down soon.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.RELEA: Just moving from one barrow to another.
Thirteenth brother, the twelve won't forget you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.REACQ: Our brother called us back. The twelve rejoice.
Don't show me to the merchant. He'll try to price me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.EVENT: Strange place. Check for sunlight first.
The twelve are split. You decide.
Brother, deliberate too long and the twelve start arguing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I move first. Don't stop me.
Whatever targets you, I cut first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: Oni come at night. I don't sleep.
Then I'll stay up with you. A little.
From the sheath, I listen to you breathe. I like that.
Step back. The rest is my job.
Onimaru asking a favor. I won't fall.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: My edge is clear. Like your heart.
For a long, long time, please.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.SWITCH: I'll cut it myself. You just watch.
In your hand, I needn't move on my own.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.ELITES: ......That's as good as an oni. I may cut it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.BOSSST: Ensifer. I leave my back to you. I'll open the front.
Right. Don't worry about your back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.BOSSVI: Even the oni king falls. When you're here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.CURSED: A masterless blade. That's what I am.
No master, maybe. But you have a comrade.
......I'm sorry. It's not that I don't accept you.
I know. That's just the curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.RELEAS: Back to cutting alone. ......A little sad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.SHOP.T: That merchant isn't an oni. Relax.
Whatever you pick, if an oni appears, I cut it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.IDLE.T: ......I'm used to waiting. The enemy isn't.
Ta-da! The light is here. Applause?
...Clap, clap.
How's my shine today? I made an effort last night.
Blinding. Literally.
Ensifer! Where shall I shine today?
The darkest spot over there.
When you call, my light gets brighter. Really.
Then I'll call more often.
One look at me and they'll be blinded.
I might be too.
Let's be flashy, like a treasure of Findias should.
Flashy, but careful.
Hold me when the turn ends. You know.
Yeah. I remember the promise.
I'll shine for you again today. And dazzle the foes.
I like both.
Naturally. I was there.
So was I.
Score my light today?
A hundred.
Your swing plus my light—pure art.
Not sure about art, but it was good.
We won! Now it's polishing time.
Got it. Sparkly clean.
Don't compare this campfire to me. It's pitiful.
I won't.
Nuada got a silver arm and took back his throne. Cool, right?
You light up whenever you talk about him.
I'll glow just a little tonight. Easy on your eyes.
Thanks for the thought.
On starless nights, I'll be your star.
The brightest one.
Oh dear, you're a mess. Wasting my light.
I'll make it worth it.
Come toward the light. The dark is dangerous.
Okay. Toward you.
You can have all my light. You can't go out!
I won't. Still bright.
Ensifer, look at me. I'll shine my brightest—just look at me!
I'm looking. Always.
Ooh, shinier! Got a mirror?
Your blade is a mirror.
The light reaches my tip. I love this.
Glad to hear.
I wish Nuada could see me now.
I'll look instead.
All this light is yours. Use it however you like.
I'll use it sparingly.
My turn at last! Spotlight, please!
You are the spotlight.
Bored without me?
A little.
You'll hold me to the end this time, right?
That's the plan.
The light has come! Begone, darkness!
Nice entrance.
Big guy, big shadow. I'll erase it.
Please.
Tough one. I need to store light—hold me at turn's end.
Got it. Let's build it up.
Look at that darkness. I have to light all of it? Tiring.
You can, right?
I'm trembling like Nuada before Balor. But let's go together.
Together. I trust your light.
See? No one escapes my light.
This time, I'll grant you that.
Right now, we're the brightest thing in the world!
So bright I might tear up.
Not a scratch. Just like me.
You'd throw a fit over one.
A flawless, shining victory! Aren't we too perfect?
We are. Admitted.
Nuada's lost arm... don't bring it up.
So you have sore spots too.
Sorry. Even my light casts a shadow.
I'll take the shadow too.
Hmph, giving up a treasure like me? You'll regret it.
Probably.
Even gone, I'll keep shining your way.
...Thank you, Solais. Goodbye.
It was dark without me, wasn't it?
Very.
I'm back! Missed me? Me too!
Yeah, I missed you.
Do they sell polish? The best kind!
I doubt it.
That merchant's lamp is dimmer than me. Want to rent me out as a light?
Never.
So gloomy. Shall I light it up?
Just a bit.
Wherever you go, I'll light the way. Choose.
Then I'll pick with confidence.
Hello? I'm shining here, aren't you looking?
I am. Just thinking.
Your thinking face is cute, but let's move.
Okay, let's go.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Fresh air at last! Make room for my swing!
When you call, the hills tremble! Haha!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: I hope there's three or more! One sweep!
I'll swing wide as a rainbow—duck!
One or ten, with you it's all fun!
Better fighting with you than with Fergus! I mean it!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Friend, your swing has rhythm now!
Let out a victory roar! Waaah!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: This fire's too small. Should be big enough to burn a hill.
Ulster's warriors held boasting contests by the fire. Try it!
I have nothing to boast about.
Shall I tell you of the Cattle Raid of Cooley? It's very long!
Friend, tonight I'll watch the fire quietly too. ...For a bit.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Hey! Tired already? There's swinging left to do!
Behind me! A big blade makes a shield too!
They dare touch my friend?! I'll sweep them all!
Laugh, friend! We've never lost while laughing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: Only as much as fits in the tomb.
Not even Lethe's blade was this good!
I still don't know who Lethe is.
This weight, this edge! Friend, your hammering is the best!
Now I could cleave three mountains, not just hills!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SWIT: My turn?! Everyone out of the way!
Haha! You needed the big blade after all?
Friend, I'll sweep them all in one go!
I feel light in your hands! No—you got stronger!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.ELIT: A hefty one! I like it!
One big one. Fine—I'll cut just as big!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.BOSS: Hahaha! It's the size of a hill! Finally, a foe my size!
Friend, this is bigger than the Cattle Raid. Let's make our names!
Names or not, let's survive together.
It's down! Hill number four! Hahaha!
This fight deserves a song! The Song of Ensifer and Caladbolg!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.FLAW: Not a scratch! I swung so big nobody got close!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.CURS: The Shield of the Unstruck King... don't ask about that day.
The price of sparing that king reached even you. Sorry, friend.
It's fine. You did the right thing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.RELE: What? Me? ...Fine, a big blade is welcome anywhere!
Friend, see me off with a smile. I'll come back loud!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REAC: Haha! I'm back! The tomb got cramped!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SHOP: Any big sheaths? These are all tiny!
Merchant! Your biggest item! ...My friend pays!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.EVEN: Hope whatever's here can be cut!
Friend, when in doubt, go big! Keep regrets small!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.IDLE: Hey! If you don't swing, I'll rust!
Friend, you can think while swinging!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.GRAM_TY: The hero's blade, still lying around broken.
The cursed blade, still showing off its golden hilt.
Both of you, stop. The enemy's over there.
Tyrfing. If your curse touches Ensifer, I cut you first.
Try it. With a broken blade.
If you want a fight, fight them.
Gram, you slew a dragon. I slew kings.
Is that something to boast of?
Today, let's both do something worth boasting about.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.DURANDA: Durandal! Let's bet who cuts more!
Dainsleif, even a bloodthirsty blade can repent.
If I repent, do I get blood?
Listen to him. He's not wrong.
I sense a curse. The relics sting.
A saint's tooth. Afraid of my curse?
Unbreakable, are you? I never rust. We're alike.
I endure by faith. What do you endure by?
Tyrfing, I will pray for you as well.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.KUSANAG: Onimaru, you too were a blade of our land.
Treasure. Have you ever cut an oni?
Don't you miss the cherry blossoms of home?
......I don't cut flowers. That's why I like them.
Let's go somewhere with flowers someday.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.CALADBO: Solais! Two blades of Ériu meet!
Lower your voice. My light's flickering.
You're all size and no sparkle.
And you're all sparkle and tiny!
You're both great in your own way.
King Nuada's blade! Fergus spoke of you!
That you were too bright to look at!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.SKOFNUN: Sigurd's blade. Five of the twelve know you.
They say they don't know any broken blade.
The twelve are whispering. Ignore them.
Sköfnung, when all twelve talk at once, Ensifer gets confused.
So today only six will talk.
There's twelve of you? So you drink twelve times the blood?
We don't drink blood. We only leave wounds.
(the twelve whisper) Högni's blade... the endless battle...
Today's fight will end. Both of you, remember that.
Two blades of the north meet. You're too loud.
Says the one with twelve voices?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.COUPLE_: Dainsleif, you'll get hurt if you're so excited.
Swords chip too. I know it well.
That one's like our son as a boy.
Am I being teased right now?
You two always stick together? Don't you get sick of it?
Not even after a thousand years.
A blade that moves on its own. Which smith made you?
Ensifer does. Keep an eye on him.
You two are so close you're blocking my light.
Oh, sorry. Shall we move apart?
Sparkling while cutting is my specialty, you know?
Stop it, both of you. You're troubling Ensifer.
Gram, how good was Regin, who forged you?
Good enough to split an anvil.
Gram, you've been with Ensifer the longest, right? Look after him.
Must be nice, traveling as two. I was always alone.
Once I'm drawn, no one escapes. So why are you the one losing?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Next to three years, a few turns is nothing.
